lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters posterior to the branchial region. Blobs are non-linearly staggered, with the largest and highest-intensity centroids localized in the mid-flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary lateral blobs, creating a discernible grid-like alignment of high-luminance anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient featuring a high-intensity dorsal edge and a lower-intensity ventral shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: Five clear vertical gill slits visible with high-contrast luminance edges; prominent pectoral fin in the lower-left foreground displaying a dense distribution of small, high-luminance spots.
